msg: Different coloured gnomes are linked to different coloured collecting baskets. The Blue, yellow, green and orange gnomes are linked to a yellow basket that appears to collect mushrooms in the forest. All other coloured gnomes are linked to a red basket.If you stick to the set of gnomes linked to the yellow basket the number of mushrooms that you collect may drop, this does seem to only be for 3 or 4 goes though, so you can try selecting one of the coloured gnomes linked to the red basket for approximately 4 goes and then go back to selecting the gnomes linked to the yellow basket. The number of mushrooms collected will probably increase again.
